label: Recipient age at examination
notes: Age of the patient at that examination. Use rows with firstobs = 1 for age at transplant.

label: Time of examination since transplant
notes: 0 on the transplant record. Use it to put each patient's visits in order.

label: Primary diagnosis (reason for transplant)
values_or_units: IHD = ischaemic heart disease; IDC = idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy; check the full list with SELECT DISTINCT

label: Cumulative number of acute rejection episodes
Health state at this examination
values_or_units: 1 = no CAV; 2 = mild/moderate CAV; 3 = severe CAV; 4 = death
notes: Main variable for the transition counts. Death is recorded at the exact date of death.

label: First observation flag
values_or_units: 1 = transplant record (first row for the patient); 0 = later angiogram or death
notes: The transplant record is in state 1 for every patient.

label: Highest state observed so far for this patient
notes: statemax is the worst state a patient has reached so far, up to and including that visit. It never goes down, even when state does.
